name: AEC Securities Public Company Limited
summary: AEC Securities Public Company Limited provides securities brokerage services to individual and institutional investors in Thailand. It offers equity services, such as cash account, cash balance account, and credit balance account; securities trading and underwriting; investment advisory; derivatives brokerage; securities borrowing and lending; private fund management; mutual funds; block trade; bonds; securities analysis; and investment banking services, including securities design and offering, debt restructuring, merger, and financial advisory services. The company was formerly known as United Securities Public Company Limited and changed its name to AEC Securities Public Company Limited in June 2013. AEC Securities Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
